description: Saves the signed-in baker's county/city, vertical ladder rung (1=Hobby, 2=Cottage Food, 3=Inspected Kitchen, 4=Commercial), and optional business name / baker name / street address on Crosodo, then returns their 4-Box municipal assessment and 6-stage journey status. Requires OAuth sign-in (crosodo:write).

fips.description: Optional 5-digit FIPS instead of state + county

state.description: 2-letter USPS state abbrev or state name

name: setup_bakery_business
title: Configure bakery county, ladder rung, and business name
